May 16, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Acropolis Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Travelers Companies Inc (TRV) by 47.81% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Acropolis Investment Management Llc bought 5,834 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.76% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 18,037 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.45 million, up from 12,203 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Acropolis Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Travelers Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $35.24B market cap company. The stock increased 0.40% or $0.52 during the last trading session, reaching $130.38. About 405,696 shares traded. The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:TRV) has risen 13.01% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.46% the S&P500.
